name: Kenya

nationalGame.name: Running
nationalGame.about: Kenya has no official national sport — but running is its crown. Kenyan runners rule the world's marathons.
nationalGame.note: Kenya has no official national sport — running is what the whole world knows Kenya for.

loved.name: Running
loved.why: Kids run miles to school — and grow up to break world records.

loved.name: Football
loved.why: Village pitches buzz with evening matches.

loved.name: Volleyball
loved.why: Kenya's women's team is a champion of Africa.

fact: Kenya's Rift Valley is called 'the home of champions' — runners train in thin mountain air that builds giant lungs.
